newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediobanca closes mark zero bond early.
newsitem.headline: Mediobanca closes mark zero bond early.

text.p: Italian investment bank Mediobanca said it had closed its 10-year, 150 million mark zero coupon bond on the first day of issue due to over-demand.
It said in a statement the offer had been closed at midday "because total demand largely exceeded the amount on offer."
The issue, the first Italian domestic bond in marks, had been due to be on public offer for two days from Tuesday.
The "Mediobanca Zero Coupon 1996-2006", issued in a single denomination of 5,000 marks at 56.30 percent, will be repaid at par on November 9, 2006. Gross annual yield is 5.91 percent.
